note: Issue #401: LAN play. One player hosts from F11 > Game, friends on the same wifi join by the host's address. Read by src/systems/net/net_session.gd. port: the UDP port the host listens on. max_players counts the host. send_rate: state packets a second each player sends. name_max: letters in a player's name. spawn_by_t89_m: how far from T-89 a guest stands on arrival. smooth_rate: how fast a remote body closes on where it was last heard (1/s); snap_m: further off than this it jumps. name_height: metres above the feet of the floating name. connect_timeout: seconds a join waits for the host before giving up. friendly_fire: your bolts and blade hurt the other players (each game applies the hits on its own player, times friendly_fire_scale); off, they pass through. hitbox_radius / hitbox_height: the other players' bodies, for shots and for walking into. Issue #402 (one town): the host's game runs the town's people and sends them npc_rate times a second (those farther than npc_far_m from every player only every npc_far_every-th time), npc_chunk to a packet; a guest's copy walks to where the host's will be npc_lead_s from now and jumps there when more than npc_snap_m off, and npc_claim_s after the first snapshot a guest's own people that copy none of the host's go. The planet's natives the same way: the packs' members ride the people's snapshots (npc_claim_s after its own are built, a guest's members the host's game no longer has go), each pack's mood and its camp's fallen tents every npc_far_every-th time, the animals as the people; a guest's copy of an animal goes at its own speed times pig_catch_up to where the host's is, and jumps when more than pig_snap_m off. peer_timeout_s: how long a player may not answer (a town loading) before the others count them gone.
